evaluations.evidence: create a new game
evaluations.rationale: Story provides the creation capability for games, which is complemented by read, update, and delete stories elsewhere in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL
evaluations.rationale: Inviting estimators is a necessary step and is not missing any complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item
evaluations.rationale: Starting a round is supported by item creation and management stories.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate
evaluations.rationale: Viewing items is supported by item creation and management stories.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Selection is supported by item creation and viewing stories.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Provides the creation capability for items, which is complemented by read, update, and delete stories.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list
evaluations.rationale: Editing is supported by item creation and viewing stories.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list
evaluations.rationale: Deletion is supported by item creation and viewing stories.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately
evaluations.rationale: Estimate creation and management are supported by other stories.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Estimate creation and acceptance are supported by other stories.

evaluations.evidence: estimate field filled in automatically
evaluations.rationale: Automatic estimate acceptance is a complementary feature, not missing any necessary capability.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Estimate entry is supported by estimate creation and management stories.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Re-estimation is supported by item and estimate management stories.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Importing stories is a complementary input method, not missing any necessary capability.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Copy/paste is a complementary input method, not missing any necessary capability.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Browsing previous games is supported by game creation and management stories.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Viewing transcripts is supported by game and estimate management stories.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Exporting is a complementary output method, not missing any necessary capability.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: Exporting is a complementary output method, not missing any necessary capability.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game
evaluations.rationale: Game deletion is supported by game creation and management stories.

evaluations.evidence: create an account
evaluations.rationale: Account creation is complemented by read, update, and delete stories.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Login is supported by account creation and management stories.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Account update is supported by account creation and management stories.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account
evaluations.rationale: Account deletion is supported by account creation and management stories.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: Timezone display is a complementary feature, not missing any necessary capability.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Password reminder is a complementary feature to account management.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, etc.} or {0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, etc.}

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: Extends the invitation capability, not missing any necessary complementary feature.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Viewing items is supported by item creation and management stories.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Viewing items is supported by item creation and management stories.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round

evaluations.evidence: start a two-minute countdown timer
